pages.text: The $(item)Nameless Sorcerer$(), a corrupt mage of unknowable origins, can be summoned using the Withered Beacon. Just activate the beacon as normal, then give it two pieces of Tainted Dust, a Totem of Undying, and either a $(item)Dusk Arc$() or $(item)Ethereal Arc$().$(br2)Which Arc you use will $(thing)determine what abilities the Nameless Sorcerer will have$()!

This summoning recipe is expensive, but don't worry! If you lose, the Nameless Sorcerer will despawn and $(thing)drop the items used to spawn it$().$(br2)Upon death, the Nameless Sorcerer will drop a powerful $(item)Totem of Vexation$(), plenty of diamonds and emeralds, and a $(item)Runic Arc$(), which when worn, will empower any other arcs you currently have equipped!
